title: Hey there, I’m Andy!
text:
Hey there, I’m Andy!


Economics & Finance student with a dashed of specialty in Data Science
I’m exploring the grey area between Finance, Economics and Data, and over-analyze most of it over these articles, and interactive projects
These articles are not limited to Finance or Economics only, but may include anything that are interesting to me also (and hopefully to you too!)







What should I do now?
There are an abundance of things for you to do here. You can check out my articles and blogs, or have a look at my history and experiences. I hope whatever bring you here will keep you here for a little bit longer.
In order to help you out, I have already “curated” an experience based on why you are here - based on my beliefs of what you want to see. Feel free to use these button to help yourself out!
